newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS-Guinness calls active, lifts stock.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS-Guinness calls active, lifts stock.

text.p: Heavy buying of Guinness Plc calls helped squeezed the underlying shares higher on Thursday, options dealers said.
Dealers noted three buyers of February 460 calls on Guinness at 12-1/2p and 13p. About 1,300 lots, equivalent to more than 500,000 shares, were bought in total, they said.
November options on Guinness, which expired yesterday, were exercised, which also contributed to the advance in Guinness shares, among the worse performers on the FTSE 100 recently.
By 1500 GMT, shares in UK brewer were up 6-1/2p to 446p.

Elsewhere, dealers noted the sale of a 1,000 lot in December 90 calls on Sears at 5p. The December 90 calls were active yesterday as well amid rumours the UK retailing group would either sell its Freemans agency mail order unit or enter into a joint venture.
Shares in Sears were off 1/2p at 92-1/2p.
Dealers also reported the sale of 500 April 700 straddles in British Petroleum, betting on a drop in volatility. A 250 lot traded in July 650 puts in BP.
Trading in FTSE 100 options was light as traders awaited the release of the UK budget on Tuesday.
The most actively traded European-style index contracts were the December 3625 puts, where more than 2,100 lots changed hands, and the December 4125 calls, where volume was approaching 1,600.
Volume in the American-style index options was heaviest in the December 3850 puts, with more than 1,200 lots trading.
